question: What fearful afterlife is imagined when ritual support and rescue are absent?
premises: A person imagines having no one to offer rice-balls.
The same person judges himself to be a great wrongdoer with no savior anywhere.
This conviction leads to the imagination of falling into a hellish ocean.
inference: The absence of imagined ritual and moral support produces a corresponding vision of helpless descent into hell.
plain_english: One thinks, 'I have no one to offer me rice-balls, I myself have done great wrong, there is no savior for me anywhere, and I am falling into the ocean of hell.'
